## Project memory policy

This file contains reviewed long-term project memory.

## Rules

- UtterPlan is engine-independent. Core code must not import PyKokoro, PiperSynth, kokorog2p, piperg2p, ONNX Runtime, audio packages, or any consumer package.
- UtterPlan ends before G2P. Engine/model selection, synthesis, and audio composition happen downstream.
- `.utterplan.toml` schema v7 is the current inter-package contract; schema-v5/v6 TOML and historical JSON schemas v1–v4 remain sequential migration inputs only, and only the current schema version is natively supported.
- Python objects may not contain semantic state that cannot survive file roundtrip.
- Public FlowPlan objects contain no phonemes, model token IDs, models, sessions, or audio; completed plans must not retain spaCy or provider documents.
- Every offset has a documented coordinate space.
- Default planning is deterministic; the same source and configuration always produce the same executable plan and `plan_id`.
- Schema changes require explicit compatibility review, frozen historical fixture coverage, deterministic migration tests, and package artifact checks.
- Released schema files are immutable and retained under versioned paths; schemas v5, v6, and v7 have no JSON Schema resources.
- Every supported older schema must retain a sequential migration path to current (v1 through v6 feed v7).
- Migrations operate on serialized plain data and may not call parser, planner, G2P, renderer, or audio stages.
- Package version and schema version remain independent. Migration preserves a compiled plan; replanning is a separate operation.
- Optional compiler traces are sidecars; they must never alter executable plan content or identity.
- UtterPlan parses SSMD 0.9 only; it does not parse SSMD 0.8 or migrate source documents (`ssmd migrate` owns that).
- Book commands (`compile-book`, `render-book`) read the SSMDBook manifest only for chapter discovery, never modify the manifest or source chapters, write derived plans to separate directories, and never build book-level combined plans.
- RenderPlan projection is optional: VoiceRender creates and validates engine-backed RenderProfiles, while UtterPlan projects stored schema-v7 FlowPlans into profile-specific RenderPlans (with `renderplan-set.toml` and reports) and performs deterministic replan refinement only.
- UtterPlan depends directly on SSMD, PhraseSplit, TTSReady, and the renderplan contract package only; production code does not import Spokenform, and spaCy stays optional best-effort enrichment.
- Repository tests must be self-contained and must not require sibling consumer checkouts; consumer-specific compatibility testing belongs in the consumer repository.
